title: Talishadi Churna
description: Talishadi Churna (Talisadi Churna) is a classical upper respiratory formulation containing Talisha Patra (Abies webbiana) and warm digestive spices. This formulation relieves dry allergic cough through moisturizing and anti-allergic action. Chronic bronchitis with persistent cough and mucus production is addressed through expectoration and tissue healing. Clears sticky phlegm that accumulates in the respiratory passages. Enhances taste buds improving taste perception for those with taste numbness. Cures low appetite through digestive stimulation combined with taste improvement.
